<!-- Generated by `deltac gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

Σ* has every word, so it's allowed only inside `lang`. Use Σ^n or Σ^≤n for a finite set.

## Example

```delta error
let Σ = {'a', 'b'}
let all = Σ*
```
